from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model_res(p, T_fun):
    cs_,pp=p[0],p[1]
    T=T_fun(pp)
    X=np.column_stack([t**2, np.sin(cs_*t)*np.sqrt(v), T, np.ones_like(t)])
    coef,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return dv_dt-X@coef
